0022600176.text: The Brooklyn Nets (1-6, 0-3 at home) host the Charlotte Hornets (3-5, on a four-game losing streak) in their eighth game of the season, with Brooklyn sitting 15th in the East and Charlotte 9th. Brooklyn will be without Egor Demin (leg bruise) and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain), while Charlotte is missing Grant Williams and Kon Knueppel, both with hamstring injuries. The Nets trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after a 110-103 home loss to Charlotte on October 21, and they lost the 2025-26 series 1-2.
